summary.name: Ink Wash Painting: a supplemental reference, not a directly named source-collection style.
summary.visualIdentity: Pressure-sensitive brush marks, diluted ink washes, empty space and restrained tonal contrast. Choose one tradition, Chinese ink wash or Japanese sumi-e, and keep its composition logic. These traditions are not interchangeable.
summary.suitableUses: Inferred fit: cultural, poetic or meditative pieces where empty space carries meaning. Subject, audience and objective are unspecified. Dense, fast explainers are not indicated by this metadata.
summary.limitations: Avoid fast camera moves, generic splash effects and added accent colours. Source review covered only seconds 1–8 of two clips; continuous motion, sub-second timing and audio were not verified.
summary.palette: Background #F4EFDF and foreground #242724 (contrast 13.129) are optional, scene-dependent suggestions, not approved exact colours. Choose the substrate per scene, such as cool grey xuan paper or dusk-blue for night. Stay monochrome, using wash opacity for tone.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Motion is unspecified beyond style guidance: slow, coherent movement with deliberate holds; springs and bounce are not mandated. Motion-012 and motion-015 are optional, unselected candidates needing scene screening.
summary.audio: Unspecified; no audio asset supplied. Inferred fit: restrained ambience or silence with reading holds, avoiding vocals that compete with copy. Any voice or music must be authorized and locally produced.
summary.assetRequirements: No assets are supplied or mandated. Use authentic ink assets or controlled Canvas brush and wash masks with consistent stroke direction. Inscriptions need real text and verified stroke paths.
summary.combinations: Ink wash works best alone. Inscription style-041 fits only a Chinese tradition, in ink-only colours. Depth style-101 uses wash opacity and slow drift. Never mix sumi-e with Chinese inscriptions.
summary.productionApproach: Canvas 2D renders brushes and washes; Python with Pillow preprocesses assets. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for timing, audio and export, using a paused GSAP timeline. Remotion is fallback only, with the reason recorded. chroma-js checks composited contrast.
